Ivy: Mum sent me this little thing. (1) ____
Noah: It's a bracelet in English. You wear it on your arm.
Ivy: (2) ____
Noah: Yes. This blue one is mine, and the red one is yours.
Ivy: I like your blue one. (3) ____
Noah: It's blue because blue is my favourite colour.
Ivy: My little cousin can't spell that colour word. (4) ____
Noah: Yes. B-L-U-E. She can copy these four letters.
Ivy: (5) ____
Noah: You're welcome.
